ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central field with approximately 30% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) coverage concentrated on the trailing boundaries and median notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity dark-grey blobs clustered at the median notch and along the trailing edges; dispersed low-intensity focal spots and mottling distributed across the high-intensity medial zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the total lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous trailing boundary characterized by high-frequency, irregular serrations with macro-level indentations, most notably a distinct concave notch on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a piecewise concave sweep from the median notch to the tips, interrupted by rugged topological peaks.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast dark circular ring located on the mid-right lobe; multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters scattered across the white ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Network of unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white medial sections of both lobes, particularly prominent on the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy texturing and significant distal erosion/barnacle colonization visible on the tips of both lobes; the right tip shows irregular geometric loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique circular 'O' shaped dark pigmentation mark located on the central white field of the right lobe.
